title: Austin Commercial Permits input
description: Inclusive local-date filtering over Austin's official Issued Construction Permits dataset. Defaults to the most recent seven calendar dates in America/Chicago and commercial permits.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD source date. If omitted, defaults with endDate to the most recent seven America/Chicago calendar dates.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD source date. Source issue_date is date-only; no timezone is inferred.

permitClass.title: Permit class
permitClass.description: Source permit class filter. Commercial is the default and uses permit_class_mapped exactly.

permitTypes.title: Permit types
permitTypes.description: Optional source permit type codes. Allowed values: BP, EP, MP, PP, DS.

descriptionKeywords.title: Description keywords
descriptionKeywords.description: Optional comma-separated, case-insensitive OR terms matched against description server-side.

requireContractor.title: Require contractor
requireContractor.description: Only return records with a non-empty contractor company name.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum delivered permits. The actor never returns more than 5,000.

includeContractorSummary.title: Include contractor summary
includeContractorSummary.description: Write a separate activity-within-delivered-records summary artifact/dataset.
